sn32.1:1.1: Tatra || voca || || Valāhakakāyike bhikkhave deve desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || Katame ca bhikkhave valāhakakāyikā devā || || Santi bhikkhave sītavalāhakādevā || santi uṇhavalāhakā devā || santi abbhavalāhakā devā || santi vātavalāhakā devā || santi vassavalāhakā devā || || Ime vuccanti bhikkhave valāhakakāyikā devā ti || ||
